Buying a UPS and a generator in Pavlodar: how we work

AEC Kazakhstan has been supplying guaranteed power systems in Pavlodar since 2021. Stock items (UPS up to 20 kVA, 12 V batteries, stabilisers up to 10 kVA) are shipped from Almaty in 2–3 days by road. Project equipment (modular UPS, gensets, OPzV batteries) is delivered directly to the customer's site from the Salicru, Tescom, Kehua and AGG Power factories.

AEC engineers travel to Pavlodar for site surveys, installation, commissioning and repairs. Call-out time is 2–3 days, with priority for service contract customers. Load testing is carried out with our own load bank, and battery diagnostics with a Fluke VT521 analyser.
Typical customers in the region: energy, metallurgy. For tenders we provide EAEU certificates, distributor letters and a project reference list.
